# Third-party assets

- **Instrument Sans** (Regular, Medium, SemiBold, Bold, Latin subset), bundled in `apps/parent-android/app/src/main/res/font/`.
  Copyright 2022 The Instrument Sans Project Authors. Licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1; the licence text is in
  `instrument-sans-OFL.txt`. Taken from the `@fontsource/instrument-sans` 5.3.0 package (OFL-1.1) and converted from WOFF to TTF
  without changing the glyphs. Text outside the Latin subset falls back to the system font.
